rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone's hometown, especially a village or rural home.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hoeng1 haa5 hai2 ciu4 zau1

rows.note: Use this more formal or general term for the place someone regards as their native home.

example.english: I have always missed my hometown.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 gaa1 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the old family home or hometown that someone comes from or returns to.

example.english: We go back to our hometown for Chinese New Year.
example.jyutping: gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 faan1 lou5 gaa1
